title: SIDESTORY: MANSFIELD BREAK OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: MANSFIELD BREAK OPEN
EVENT DURATION: June 22, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – July 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Mansfield Break event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
[Escape Plan] Duration: June 22, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – July 6, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Mansfield Daily Life] Duration: June 29, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – July 6, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[BE PREPARED]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Be Prepared] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Robin, Mansfield Prison Cell Furniture (Pieces), Factory Steels.
[SECRET CHANNEL]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Factory Steels by clearing event stages and Be Prepared missions. Factory Steels can be used to redeem items from Secret Channel.
MAIN REWARDS: Robin's Token, Mansfield Prison Cell Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Record, Elite Materials, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – JAIL TIGER UNCHAINED
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Jail Tiger Unchained", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Mountain
★★★★★: Kafka / Silence
★★★★: Pinecone
03 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE IN HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting “Jail Tiger Unchained”, and will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
★★★★★★: Mountain
★★★★★: Kafka
★★★★: Pinecone
NOTE:
Operator Robin is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Mansfield Break. Operator Robin is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
Mountain, Kafka, Robin, and Pinecone will gain more trust during this event.
04 TEST COLLECTION & ICEFIELD MESSENGER NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Test Collection – The Law for Saria
Icefield Messenger Collection – Candy Cape for Weedy
Icefield Messenger Collection - Snowy Echo for Elysium
Icefield Messenger Collection – Snowywatch for Firewatch
05 ICEFIELD MESSENGER COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Icefield Messenger Collection – Presents for Schwarz
Icefield Messenger Collection - York's Bise for SilverAsh
Icefield Messenger Collection – Caster's Frost for Pramanix
06 NEW FURNITURE SET – MANSFIELD PRISON CELL
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Mansfield Prison Cell, will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Mansfield Break event rewards and redeem in Secret Channel (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from June 22, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – July 6, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
